title: Backend Engineer (Python)

s1: - Designed REST APIs in Python (FastAPI) serving 4k requests per second.
- Owned the PostgreSQL schema for the ledger; tuned queries with EXPLAIN and partial indexes.
- Built a pytest suite with 92% coverage and contract tests between services.
- Deployed services on AWS (ECS, RDS) using Docker images built in CI.
- Python and Django REST Framework APIs; PostgreSQL migrations; Celery workers.
s2: - Built Python microservices exposing REST and webhook APIs for 300 logistics partners.
- Modelled PostgreSQL schemas with row-level partitioning; wrote complex SQL reports.
- Introduced integration tests with pytest and Testcontainers in GitHub Actions.
- Containerised all services with Docker and ran them on Kubernetes in Google Cloud.
s3: - Python (Flask) REST APIs for patient scheduling; OpenAPI-first design and versioning.
- PostgreSQL: designed tables, indexes and read replicas; reduced p95 query time by 70%.
- Unit and end-to-end tests with pytest and Playwright; TDD on new endpoints.
- AWS Lambda and RDS deployments with Terraform; Docker for local development.
s4: - Python data APIs (REST, gRPC) used by 40 internal teams.
- Ran PostgreSQL at scale: logical replication, vacuum tuning, query optimisation.
- Wrote property-based tests (Hypothesis) and load tests; owned CI quality gates.
- Built Docker base images and AWS EKS deployment pipelines.
m1: - Built websites and small APIs with Python and Django.
- Used MySQL and some PostgreSQL for client projects.
- Wrote a few unit tests for critical views.
m2: - Wrote Python scripts and complex SQL queries in PostgreSQL for reporting.
- Exposed a couple of internal endpoints with Flask.
- Scheduled jobs on an AWS EC2 instance.
m3: - Node.js and Express REST APIs, with some Python scripts for data imports.
- Jest unit tests; Docker Compose for local setup.
m4: - Python FastAPI endpoints for the mobile app.
- Wrote SQL migrations with Alembic on PostgreSQL.
- Added pytest tests for new features.
w1: - Brand identities, packaging and social media campaigns.
w2: - Led a team of 8 agents; improved CSAT to 94%.
- Wrote help-centre articles and macros in Zendesk.
w3: - HTML, CSS and React components for the marketing site.
- Fixed accessibility bugs reported by QA.
w4: - Sold SaaS subscriptions to mid-market clients; 120% of quota.
